req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that POST /players/ must accept payloads without a nickname field, treating nickname as optional. Examining the source, PlayerRequestModel has no 'nickname' field at all; the optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, and starting11. The requirement's intent maps to: a minimal payload (only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) must be accepted with HTTP 201. We test: (1) positive EP — payload with only required fields, no optional fields, gets 201 and correct response body; (2) positive EP — payload with all optional fields explicitly included also gets 201; (3) boundary BVA — squad_number at boundary value 27 (one above the 26 pre-loaded rows) with minimal payload; (4) negative NEG — payload missing a required field (first_name) gets 422; (5) DT — payload with optional fields set to null explicitly still gets 201; (6) BVA — squad_number at boundary 0 (edge of integer domain) with minimal payload.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 27 is not in the database
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number=27, position
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), first_name, last_name, squad_number=27, position
Optional fields (middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11) are null or absent
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without optional fields
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "TestFirst",
        "lastName": "TestLast",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "TestFirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "TestLast"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201()
